pages.text: When the smeltery holds the right molten fluids and is hot enough, it combines them into an $(l)alloy$(). Three parts molten copper plus one part molten zinc become four parts molten brass.

Alloying runs automatically every tick the inputs and temperature are satisfied — no interaction needed. Pour the inputs in, keep the smeltery hot, and drain the alloy back out.$(br2)Check JEI for the full list of alloy recipes.
